desc: control the laptop case fans using the recorded fan hotkey: boost to max, quiet down, or toggle the current fan mode

params.name: action
params.desc: max (spin the fans up), quiet (drop to silent), or toggle (flip the current mode)

params.name: file
params.desc: path to a recorded_key.json file (default: recorded_key.json in the ZARS root)

keywords: set my pc fans to max
examples: set my pc fans to max
